fields.description: Program Description 1. Educational Objectives and Basic Standards Editor Notes: Through these courses, the students will build a solid theory foundation of environmental science and engineering; will possess the knowledge of pollution control, such as water, air, solid and noise pollution control. 1. Goals The goal of this program is to train the students to develop in morality, intelligence and physique, and have the concept of sustainable development. Through these courses, the students will build a solid theory foundation of environmental science and engineering; will possess the knowledge of pollution control, such as water, air, solid and noise pollution control; will have the ability of pollution control design, environmental planning and environmental assessment; will be able to know the advanced developments, theories and technologies in research field of environmental science and engineering; will be qualified to do monitoring, design, management, education and research work in government departments (environmental protection, environmental planning etc.), industrial enterprises, research institutes, colleges; and will be talents, who are with continuous learning and innovation ability in environmental science and technology field. 2. Basic standards (1) Knowledge: master mathematics, physics, chemistry and other scientific knowledge; grasp the basic theories and methods of environmental science and engineering; have necessary basic knowledge of engineering and humanities, social and economic management. (2) Capacity: have knowledge and ability about analysis of environmental monitoring data, environmental pollution prevention and control, such as water, gas, and solid, environmental planning and management and so on; understand the frontier and the development of this major; have a primary ability to investigate, develop and design new products, new technologies, new processes and new equipment in the field of environmental engineering. (3) Engineering quality: have basic training in experiment skills, engineering practice, computer application, scientific research and engineering design of environmental engineering, chemistry and chemical engineering; understand the national guidelines, policies and regulations for the project design, production, research and development, operation and management, planning and evaluation in the field of environmental engineering. (4) Special requirements: have good humanistic literacy, team consciousness and ability in organization and coordination; have the concept of sustainable development; have care concept of protecting human health, maintaining ecological safety and improving environmental quality; have good professional ethics and norms. ​ 2. Curriculums and Credits Editor Notes: You can learn more details of curriculum and credits from the following table. (1) General Curriculum (2) Basic Courses (3) Professional Core Courses (4) Professional Extension courses (5) Practical Courses 3. Credit Requirement Editor Notes: Students are required to complete at least 123 credits before graduation. Requirements for courses and credits: 35 credits for general curriculum①, 27 credits for basic courses, 27 credits for professional core courses, 5 credits for professional extension courses, 10 credits for basic practical courses, 19 credits for advanced practical courses. At least 123 credits are required for graduation. The students must pass the final defense in the last semester. 4. Abilities of the graduates Editor Notes: You need to obtain all the following abilities until you can graduate successfully. 1. Have good humanities and social science accomplishment, strong sense of social responsibility and good professional ethics; be able to comply with professional ethics and fulfill their responsibilities in the work practice. 2. Have the knowledge of engineering, mathematics and natural sciences, and the ability to apply the knowledge in a multidisciplinary environment. 3. Have strong language skills and application ability, can carry out effective technical communication and international academic exchanges with industry peers and the public about complex engineering problems; have international vision and cross-cultural communication, competition and cooperation ability. 4. Enable to apply the basic principles of applied mathematics, natural science and engineering knowledge, to identify, express, and analyze complex environmental engineering problems through literature research. 5. Master the basic theory and knowledge of environmental engineering, have basic knowledge of engineering science, such as chemistry, chemical engineering, engineering mechanics, electrics and electronics, computer technology, engineering drawing and engineering management, understand the forefront and development trend of this major. 6. Master the professional knowledge of environmental chemistry, ecological environment, environmental monitoring and environmental planning and so on, enable to explore, investigate, find and solve complex environmental problems in the view of ecosystem, and have the ability of monitoring pollutants, detecting and analyzing pollutants in the process of environmental pollution control and environmental planning and management. 7. Gain the basic skills such as design, calculation, experiment, test, analysis and equipment operation, which are required for solving environmental engineering problems. 8. Have preliminary capabilities for scientific research and technology development, have innovation awareness and preliminary ability to research, develop and design new products, new processes, new technologies and new equipment. 9. Have basic ability of searching literature, querying data, and obtaining information by modern information technology, enable to select and use proper engineering tools to reasonably predict and simulate complex engineering problems. 10. Master the basic knowledge of project and engineering management, and have the ability of operation management. 11. Have the ability of organization and management as well as interpersonal skills, be qualified as leader or group member in a multidisciplinary team. 12. Have the ability to adapt to the development of environmental engineering technology, have correct understanding of lifelong learning and self-learning ability. 5. Introduction of Zhejiang Normal University Editor Notes: ZJNU is one of the top 100 universities inChina. Chemistry, Physics and Engineering are the three top 1% disciplines in the world according to the ESI (Essential Science Index) global ranking. Founded in 1956, Zhejiang Normal University (ZJNU) covers two campuses in Zhangjiang province. The main one is located in one of the four metropolitan areas in Zhejiang Province—Jinhua—Yiwu Metropolitan area. Jinhua enjoys very convenient transportation with 40 minutes to Hangzhou and 100 minutes to Shanghai by the high-speed rail. The branch campus is in Hangzhou, the capital of the province. Its green and beautiful campus furnishes an ideal place for living, study and work. Learn More>> 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: Colorful extracurricular activities are held in ZJNU every year. Renju Chess Experience Activity ​​ Chocolate Making Activity ​​​

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Registration photo 2-inch recent colored photo. * 2. A valid ordinary passport, expiring after February 28, 2027. * 3. Police Certificate(within 6 months) * 4. English language proficiency Certificate for students whose native language is not English * 5. Copy of your notarized high school diploma Prospective students must submit official proof of student status by their current school. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. Please take the original copy of your current highest diploma with you for registration. * 6. Copy of your high school academic transcripts Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.) or UEC/A Level/ AP/IB/ SAT/ACT result. * 7. Certificate of Your Mother's Nationality(ID card or passport) * 8. Certificate of Your Father's Nationality(ID card or passport) * 9. Physical examination record for foreigner Complete it in Chinese or English, The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take physical examination as the result is valid for only 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . 10. Study Plan Written in the language of instruction of the program, no less than 1,000 words. * 11. International Student Mental Health Questionnaire https://forms.gle/HRm2CNcmPzxbTfCj6 Please finish the test and submit the screenshot when you finish the test. 12. Other supporting documents Paper published, volunteering certificates, etc. * 13. Bank Statement To prove that the applicant has sufficient funds to cover his or her tuition, accommodation, living expenses and international travels during his or her study in China. Only applicant himself/herself or his/her family can act as a financial sponsor. * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . * 15. A statement of no drug addiction history You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
